1482: fn ci_mode_policy_valid(ci: &YamlValue, issues: &mut Vec<String>) {
1483:     let expected_bases = BTreeSet::from([
1484:         "main",
1485:         "cod103-stack/cod-105",
1486:         "cod103-stack/cod-106",
1487:         "cod103-stack/cod-56",
1488:         "cod103-stack/cod-107",
1489:         "cod103-stack/cod-108",
1490:     ])
1491:     .into_iter()
1492:     .map(str::to_string)
1493:     .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1494:     let expected_events = BTreeSet::from([
1495:         "opened",
1496:         "synchronize",
1497:         "reopened",
1498:         "edited",
1499:         "labeled",
1500:         "unlabeled",
1501:     ])
1502:     .into_iter()
1503:     .map(str::to_string)
1504:     .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1505:     if !yaml_matches_string_set(
1506:         yaml_path(ci, &["on", "pull_request", "branches"]),
1507:         &expected_bases,
1508:     ) || !yaml_matches_string_set(
1509:         yaml_path(ci, &["on", "pull_request", "types"]),
1510:         &expected_events,
1511:     ) || !yaml_matches_string_set(
1512:         yaml_path(ci, &["on", "push", "branches"]),
1513:         &BTreeSet::from(["main".to_string()]),
1514:     ) || yaml_mapping_key_set(yaml_path(ci, &["on"]))
1515:         != Some(BTreeSet::from([
1516:             "pull_request".to_string(),
1517:             "push".to_string(),
1518:         ]))
1519:     {
1520:         issues.push("FAIL: ci-mode-trigger-invalid: preserve main push and the exact approved pull request bases and activities.".to_string());
1521:     }
1522: 
1523:     let jobs = yaml_path(ci, &["jobs"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1524:     let classify = yaml_path(ci, &["jobs", "classify"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1525:     let identity = workflow_step_id(classify, "identity").unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1526:     let trusted_base = workflow_step_id(classify, "trusted-base").unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1527:     let git_objects = workflow_step_id(classify, "git-objects").unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1528:     let decision = workflow_step_id(classify, "decision").unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1529:     let classify_outputs = yaml_path(classify, &["outputs"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1530:     let classify_perms = yaml_path(classify, &["permissions"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1531:     let trusted_run = yaml_path(trusted_base, &["with"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1532:     let objects_run = yaml_path(git_objects, &["with"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1533:     let identity_run = yaml_path(identity, &["run"])
1534:         .and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1535:         .unwrap_or_default();
1536:     let decision_run = yaml_path(decision, &["run"])
1537:         .and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1538:         .unwrap_or_default();
1539:     let expected_classify_outputs = BTreeSet::from(["mode".to_string(), "decision".to_string()]);
1540:     let classify_valid = yaml_path(classify, &["name"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1541:         == Some("classify CI mode")
1542:         && yaml_path(classify_perms, &["contents"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str) == Some("read")
1543:         && yaml_path(classify_perms, &["pull-requests"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1544:             == Some("read")
1545:         && yaml_mapping_key_set(Some(classify_outputs)) == Some(expected_classify_outputs)
1546:         && yaml_path(classify_outputs, &["mode"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1547:             == Some("${{ steps.decision.outputs.mode }}")
1548:         && yaml_path(classify_outputs, &["decision"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1549:             == Some("${{ steps.decision.outputs.decision }}")
1550:         && yaml_path(identity, &["env", "GH_TOKEN"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1551:             == Some("${{ github.token }}")
1552:         && yaml_path(identity, &["env", "REPOSITORY_ID"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1553:             == Some("${{ github.repository_id }}")
1554:         && identity_run.contains(".user.id == 41898282")
1555:         && identity_run.contains("autorelease: pending")
1556:         && identity_run.contains("$main[0].object.sha")
1557:         && yaml_path(trusted_base, &["if"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1558:             == Some("steps.identity.outputs.candidate == 'true'")
1559:         && yaml_path(trusted_base, &["continue-on-error"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_bool)
1560:             == Some(true)
1561:         && yaml_path(trusted_run, &["ref"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1562:             == Some("${{ steps.identity.outputs.base_sha }}")
1563:         && yaml_path(trusted_run, &["path"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str) == Some("trusted-base")
1564:         && yaml_path(trusted_run, &["persist-credentials"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_bool)
1565:             == Some(false)
1566:         && yaml_path(git_objects, &["if"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1567:             == Some("steps.identity.outputs.candidate == 'true'")
1568:         && yaml_path(git_objects, &["continue-on-error"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_bool)
1569:             == Some(true)
1570:         && yaml_path(objects_run, &["ref"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1571:             == Some("${{ steps.identity.outputs.base_sha }}")
1572:         && yaml_path(objects_run, &["path"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str) == Some("git-objects")
1573:         && yaml_path(objects_run, &["persist-credentials"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_bool)
1574:             == Some(false)
1575:         && yaml_path(decision, &["env", "CANDIDATE"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1576:             == Some("${{ steps.identity.outputs.candidate }}")
1577:         && yaml_path(decision, &["env", "TRUSTED_BASE_OUTCOME"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1578:             == Some("${{ steps.trusted-base.outcome }}")
1579:         && yaml_path(decision, &["env", "OBJECT_STORE_OUTCOME"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1580:             == Some("${{ steps.git-objects.outcome }}")
1581:         && decision_run.contains("trusted-base/crates/xtask/src/ci.rs")
1582:         && decision_run.contains("git-objects")
1583:         && decision_run.contains("cargo run -p xtask --locked --")
1584:         && decision_run.contains("ci-mode --repo")
1585:         && decision_run.contains("classifier-invalid-output")
1586:         && decision_run.contains("positive_metadata");
1587:     if !classify_valid {
1588:         issues.push("FAIL: ci-mode-classifier-invalid: classify must bind current trusted identity, immutable B execution, separate H objects, and a validated full/lightweight decision.".to_string());
1589:     }
1590: 
1591:     let policy = yaml_path(jobs, &["repository-policy"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1592:     let policy_steps = yaml_path(policy, &["steps"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_sequence);
1593:     let policy_runs: Vec<&str> = policy_steps
1594:         .into_iter()
1595:         .flatten()
1596:         .filter_map(|step| yaml_path(step, &["run"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str))
1597:         .collect();
1598:     let publication_job = yaml_path(jobs, &["publish-dry-run"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1599:     let repository_policy_valid = policy_runs
1600:         .iter()
1601:         .filter(|run| **run == "cargo run -p xtask --locked -- release-gate")
1602:         .count()
1603:         == 1
1604:         && policy_runs.contains(&"cargo test -p xtask --locked")
1605:         && policy_runs.len() == 2
1606:         && !yaml_contains_string(
1607:             publication_job,
1608:             "cargo run -p xtask --locked -- release-gate",
1609:         );
1610:     if !repository_policy_valid {
1611:         issues.push("FAIL: repository-policy-job-invalid: repository-policy must own exactly one release-gate and the bounded xtask regression suite.".to_string());
1612:     }
1613: 
1614:     let full_jobs_valid = ["clippy", "publish-dry-run", "native"].iter().all(|job| {
1615:         yaml_path(jobs, &[job, "needs"])
1616:             .and_then(yaml_string_set)
1617:             .is_some_and(|needs| needs.contains("classify"))
1618:             && yaml_path(jobs, &[job, "if"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1619:                 == Some("needs.classify.outputs.mode == 'full'")
1620:     });
1621:     if !full_jobs_valid {
1622:         issues.push("FAIL: ci-mode-full-jobs-invalid: each heavy job must require the explicit full selector result.".to_string());
1623:     }
1624: 
1625:     let required = yaml_path(jobs, &["required"]).unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1626:     let required_step = yaml_step_by_name(required, "Require current mode and mandatory jobs")
1627:         .unwrap_or(&YamlValue::Null);
1628:     let required_run = yaml_path(required_step, &["run"])
1629:         .and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1630:         .unwrap_or_default();
1631:     let required_needs = BTreeSet::from([
1632:         "classify",
1633:         "fmt",
1634:         "supply-chain",
1635:         "repository-policy",
1636:         "clippy",
1637:         "publish-dry-run",
1638:         "native",
1639:         "native_retention",
1640:     ])
1641:     .into_iter()
1642:     .map(str::to_string)
1643:     .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1644:     let needs = yaml_path(required, &["needs"]).and_then(yaml_string_set);
1645:     let required_valid = needs == Some(required_needs)
1646:         && yaml_path(required, &["if"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str) == Some("${{ always() }}")
1647:         && yaml_path(required_step, &["env", "RESULTS"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1648:             == Some("${{ toJSON(needs) }}")
1649:         && yaml_path(required_step, &["env", "DECISION"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1650:             == Some("${{ needs.classify.outputs.decision }}")
1651:         && yaml_path(required_step, &["env", "GH_TOKEN"]).and_then(YamlValue::as_str)
1652:             == Some("${{ github.token }}")
1653:         && required_run.contains("repository-policy")
1654:         && required_run.contains("native_retention")
1655:         && required_run.contains("positive_metadata")
1656:         && required_run.contains("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY")
1657:         && required_run.contains("git/ref/heads/main")
1658:         && required_run.contains("pulls/$number");
1659:     if !required_valid {
1660:         issues.push("FAIL: ci-mode-required-invalid: required must check the exact eight result keys, decision identity, mode-specific results, and final PR freshness.".to_string());
1661:     }
1662: }
